title: createQueryPersister
subtitle: Create a persister for qortex-query
description: Create a persistence adapter that connects qortex-query to a qortex-db instance. Supports localStorage, sessionStorage, and IndexedDB via the provided DB driver.

rows.name: db
rows.description: A qortex-db instance created via createDB().

rows.name: config.burstKey
rows.description: Cache-bust key. When changed, stale persisted data is discarded.

rows.name: config.storageKey
rows.description: Key used inside the DB to store the snapshot.

rows.name: config.debounceTime
rows.description: Debounce delay (ms) before writing to DB.

returns.description: An object compatible with qortex-query's Persister interface.

examples.title: Basic Usage
examples.description: Connect qortex-query to an IndexedDB instance

callouts.title: Subpath Export
callouts.content: Import from 'qortex-db/query' to ensure better tree-shaking. The main 'qortex-db' package only exports the core DB driver.

callouts.title: Async Safe
callouts.content: The persister automatically waits for the initial async DB read to finish before allowing any writes, preventing race conditions.
